_comment: Read routes that answer a caller with no credentials. MAY ONLY SHRINK. 'answers_anonymously' returned 2xx; 'inconclusive' returned something other than 2xx/401/403, so the handler may have run. Every entry carries the reason it is allowed to stay. Regenerate nothing: add or remove single entries by hand.

answers_anonymously.GET /.well-known/ai-market.json: Machine-readable discovery document; public by protocol.
answers_anonymously.GET /.well-known/mcp.json: Machine-readable discovery document; public by protocol.
answers_anonymously.GET /acp/manifest: Protocol manifest an agent reads before it has a credential.
answers_anonymously.GET /agents/packs: Static catalogue of agent packs; deploy/analyze are gated.
answers_anonymously.GET /billing/addons: Public price list and add-on catalogue; no tenant data. webhook/health reports only whether the webhook secret is configured.
answers_anonymously.GET /billing/addons/bundles: Public price list and add-on catalogue; no tenant data. webhook/health reports only whether the webhook secret is configured.
answers_anonymously.GET /billing/tiers: Public price list and add-on catalogue; no tenant data. webhook/health reports only whether the webhook secret is configured.
answers_anonymously.GET /billing/webhook/health: Public price list and add-on catalogue; no tenant data. webhook/health reports only whether the webhook secret is configured.
answers_anonymously.GET /deploy/status: Public status page data (site, portal and dashboard read it).
answers_anonymously.GET /doc-converter/formats: Static list of supported file types.
answers_anonymously.GET /filter/file/supported-types: Static list of supported file types.
answers_anonymously.GET /health: Liveness/readiness; consumed by the proxy, monitors and the status page.
answers_anonymously.GET /health/pipeline: Liveness/readiness; consumed by the proxy, monitors and the status page.
answers_anonymously.GET /kya/trust/{did}: Public DID trust lookup - the point of KYA is that a stranger can check an agent. /kya/list is gated.
answers_anonymously.GET /marketplace/agents: Public agent directory and per-agent public trust/certificate/KYA status - the counterparty check an unknown agent runs first. Not yet reviewed field by field.
answers_anonymously.GET /marketplace/agents/{agent_id}/trust: Public agent directory and per-agent public trust/certificate/KYA status - the counterparty check an unknown agent runs first. Not yet reviewed field by field.
answers_anonymously.GET /marketplace/analytics/agents: Aggregate marketplace statistics shown on the public site. recent-trades should be re-reviewed when a real trade exists.
answers_anonymously.GET /marketplace/analytics/chart-data: Aggregate marketplace statistics shown on the public site. recent-trades should be re-reviewed when a real trade exists.
answers_anonymously.GET /marketplace/analytics/model-tiers: Aggregate marketplace statistics shown on the public site. recent-trades should be re-reviewed when a real trade exists.
answers_anonymously.GET /marketplace/analytics/recent-trades: Aggregate marketplace statistics shown on the public site. recent-trades should be re-reviewed when a real trade exists.
answers_anonymously.GET /marketplace/analytics/summary: Aggregate marketplace statistics shown on the public site. recent-trades should be re-reviewed when a real trade exists.
answers_anonymously.GET /marketplace/analytics/volume: Aggregate marketplace statistics shown on the public site. recent-trades should be re-reviewed when a real trade exists.
answers_anonymously.GET /marketplace/listings: Marketplace discovery - an agent must find goods before it has a relationship with us (asserted public in #701).
answers_anonymously.GET /marketplace/proposals: Governance proposals are public by design; nothing tenant-scoped.
answers_anonymously.GET /marketplace/protocol: Marketplace protocol description; public by decision in #701.
answers_anonymously.GET /marketplace/protocol/schema/{action: Marketplace protocol description; public by decision in #701.
answers_anonymously.GET /marketplace/readiness/{community_id: Community marketplace-readiness checklist read by the portal hub page without a gateway key. Discloses five booleans per community id; gate when the portal proxies it.
answers_anonymously.GET /marketplace/stats: Aggregate marketplace statistics shown on the public site.
answers_anonymously.GET /mcp/: MCP descriptor and price list; discovery precedes any credential.
answers_anonymously.GET /mcp/pricing: MCP descriptor and price list; discovery precedes any credential.
answers_anonymously.GET /obsidian/stats: Static integration descriptor; no tenant data.
answers_anonymously.GET /scan/extensions/database: Static extension-risk reference list (same class as /scan/email, public by decision in #248).
answers_anonymously.GET /soc/health: Aggregate liveness, same content class as /health.
answers_anonymously.GET /threat/neutralizer/hierarchy: Static reference taxonomy; no tenant data.
answers_anonymously.GET /threat/neutralizer/matrix: Static reference taxonomy; no tenant data.
answers_anonymously.GET /threat/neutralizer/sectors: Static reference taxonomy; no tenant data.
